license_required.quote: shall apply to the board for a license so to do

issuing_authority.quote: The State Board of Medical Examiners, hereinafter in this chapter designated as the "board," shall, in addition to the examinations provided for in chapter 9 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes, hold meetings for the examination of all applicants under this chapter for a license to practice podiatric medicine

degree_required.quote: He has received a doctorate degree in podiatric medicine

accrediting_body.quote: in a legally incorporated American school or college of podiatric medicine, requiring personal attendance, in good standing in the opinion of said board

required.quote: Thereafter he has served a residency in a duly licensed clinic, hospital, or institution, approved by the board, for 1 full year devoted to the practice of podiatric medicine in all its branches.

duration.quote: served a residency in a duly licensed clinic, hospital, or institution, approved by the board, for 1 full year

kind.quote: he has served a residency in a duly licensed clinic, hospital, or institution, approved by the board, for 1 full year devoted to the practice of podiatric medicine in all its branches

exams.name: State Board of Medical Examiners examination
exams.notes: Examination held at the capitol building on the third Tuesday of June and October of each year
exams.quote: hold meetings for the examination of all applicants under this chapter for a license to practice podiatric medicine in this State

interval_years.quote: Every licensed podiatrist shall procure every two years from the executive director of the board, on or before November 1, a biennial certificate of registration

available.quote: any legally qualified podiatrist of another State from taking charge of the practice of a legally qualified podiatrist of this State temporarily on written permission of the board

requirements.value: Written permission of the board required; permitted for up to 3 months upon payment of $10.00 fee, extendable for up to 6 months upon payment of additional $10.00 fee and board discretion.
requirements.quote: Such permission may be granted for a period of not more than 3 months upon payment of a fee of $10.00. The board, in its discretion and upon payment of an additional fee of $10.00, may extend such permission for a further period but not to exceed 6 months.

definition_quote.value: surgery and bandaging pertaining to the ailments of the feet or ankles
definition_quote.quote: surgery and bandaging pertaining to the ailments of the feet or ankles

methods_authorized.quote: Practical podiatric medicine, podiatric orthopedics, dermatology, diagnosis, anatomy, physiology, therapeutics in all its branches, pathology, histology, bacteriology, pharmacy and materia medica, chemistry, surgery and bandaging pertaining to the ailments of the feet or ankles

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: surgery and bandaging pertaining to the ailments of the feet or ankles

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: surgery and bandaging pertaining to the ailments of the feet or ankles

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: A podiatrist licensed pursuant to chapter 5 of Title 45 of the Revised Statutes shall not use an employee to administer physical modalities to patients unless that employee is a health care provider licensed in this State.

professional_liability_insurance_require.quote: A podiatrist who maintains a professional practice in this State and has responsibility for patient care is required to be covered by malpractice liability insurance

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: Nothing in this act shall prohibit the fitting, recommending or sale of corrective shoes, arch supports or other mechanical appliances by retail dealers or manufacturers
